verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents agent-initiated payment settlement in detail. Buyers issue committed-amount pay/kya-pay tokens, sellers collect through the Charge Token API, and "Skyfire moves the funds between the buyer's and seller's wallets" within documented windows (24-hour post-expiry charge grace, settlement up to 51 hours). Nothing in the evidence says this settlement happens in stablecoins: wallets are described as pre-funded or "Credits" wallets, and the only external rail named is card networks. Settlement itself also runs through Skyfire's proprietary APIs rather than an open on-chain rail. Missing for 10: any evidence of stablecoin denomination or settlement (e.g., USDC), documentation of the underlying settlement rail or chain, independent or hands-on confirmation of settlement.
